scripts.//-- setup --: One-time bootstrap after a fresh clone; setup:e2e adds the Chromium build Playwright needs (test:web:e2e). The backend (dev:db:*, test:backend:db, gen:types) also needs Docker running and the Supabase CLI on PATH.
scripts.//-- db --: Local Supabase stack (apps/backend, Postgres 17): API 54721, DB 54722, Studio 54723, Mailpit 54724. Needs Docker. Migrations + pgTAP tests in apps/backend/supabase.
scripts.//-- web --: SvelteKit 3 (Svelte 5) on port 7790 (docs/STACK.md): prerendered marketing pages, plus a browser-only member area (/signin, /app) on the local stack. dev:run:web reads the publishable key from `supabase status` (never writes it to a file); demo sign-in needs dev:db:up first.
scripts.//-- check --: Typecheck every workspace. check:edge needs Deno on the machine; CI's runners don't ship it, so it stays out of the `check` chain and the edge tests run via test:edge on demand. check:mobile needs the Flutter SDK; CI's runners don't ship it either, so it stays out of the `check` chain and the CI mobile job runs it after bootstrapping the SDK.
scripts.//-- test --: Vitest unit tests beside the modules they cover, the root-scripts guard, and pgTAP (schema, invariants, RLS). test:backend:db needs dev:db:up first. test:web:e2e (Playwright, apps/web/e2e) builds the site and serves it on 7790, needs setup:e2e once, and is not part of `test`. test:mobile (Flutter, apps/mobile) needs the Flutter SDK installed (`flutter --version` answers; docs/STACK.md names the location).
scripts.test: pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run test:invariants && pnpm run test:docs && pnpm run test:edge && pnpm run test:backend:db && pnpm run test:mobile
scripts.//-- gen --: Regenerate apps/backend/supabase/database.types.ts from the live local schema (needs dev:db:up). Commit the result.
